concern_summary: Rendering and displaying a user's display name with appropriate styling, tooltips, and formatting, including handling conditions such as truncation or fallback names.
Managing user display names in various contexts, including fallback mechanisms and validations to ensure proper representation in the UI.
Retrieving and displaying display names for participants in a chat or report context, ensuring recognition and usability.
Concern focused on the display and selection of transactional names, their reimbursement status, and whether a transaction should be classified as billable or not.
Validating user input for display names to ensure compliance with specific criteria, maintaining the integrity and usability of names.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to displaying full titles and names, providing fallback options, and managing full name processing, ensuring user entities are represented correctly and comprehensively.
This concern involves functionalities related to capturing and providing context for user-saved search names, allowing users to rename and organize their searches effectively.

This concern focuses on error handling and violation messaging within the context of display names. It encompasses the retrieval of error fields and localized messages related to specific violations, ensuring a comprehensive approach to managing user feedback and display name validation.
